channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico reporters denied access to White House following Trump ban
item.description: Three reporters were blocked from the White House grounds Saturday morning, a day after President Trump said CNN, Politico, and MS NOW would be banned for reporting "FICTION and LIES."

item.title: Ever wonder how the Fed's interest rate actually works? We've got answers
item.description: The Federal Reserve just raised interest rates this week for the first time this year. So how does it actually work? And what does it mean for the economy — and the rest of us? Here are some answers.

item.title: Russia holds parliamentary vote in areas it seized from Ukraine in the war
item.description: Russia's parliamentary election for the first time is being held in Ukraine's regions that Moscow illegally annexed after the start of its full-scale invasion more than 4 1/2 years ago.

item.title: U.S. and Denmark reach deal to build U.S. military presence in Greenland
item.description: President Trump says he has a deal with Denmark to bolster the U.S. military presence in Greenland. The announcement comes after months of threatening to take the island by force from the NATO ally.

item.title: Search underway for suspected gunman outside Notre Dame football game vs Michigan State
item.description: Police launched a search near Eddy Street Commons for a suspected gunman as Notre Dame's football game against Michigan State was still underway.

item.title: New Jersey mom charged with obstruction after 'missing' son found hiding in her crawl space
item.description: A New Jersey mother reportedly told East Brunswick police her missing teen wasn't home, but officers found the juvenile hiding in a crawl space in her basement.

item.title: Ed Sheeran apologizes for Macklemore backlash, encourages unity at first concert since fallout
item.description: Pro-Palestinian protesters waved flags and chanted outside Ed Sheeran's Philadelphia concert, one week after Macklemore was dropped from the tour. Sheeran addressed the issue with his fans before Saturday's concert.

item.title: NORAD F-16 intercepts aircraft that violated restricted airspace over Camp David with Trump present: officials
item.description: A NORAD F-16 reportedly intercepted an aircraft violating restricted airspace over Camp David Saturday while President Donald Trump stayed there.

item.title: Trump announces new 'AI Force,' vows to protect industry as AI czar announcement nears
item.description: Trump's new AI Force mirrors his first-term Space Force creation, with a high-IQ "czar" appointment coming soon to oversee the booming industry.

item.title: Farmers want relief from Congress. Here’s the holdup.
item.description: The current farm bill expires at the end of September, but most of the funding for programs in the law will not run out until the end of the year.

item.title: How the surging cost of going out is changing American life
item.description: With the cost of concerts, sports games and restaurants far outpacing inflation, more people are staying home.

item.title: Appeals court says Trump administration’s third-country deportation policy is unlawful
item.description: The decision marks a major setback for the administration, which has removed tens of thousands of unauthorized immigrants to countries where they are not citizens.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW, Politico say journalists blocked from White House after Trump announces ban
item.description: President Donald Trump said Friday he would block MS NOW, CNN and Politico from White House grounds. News outlets and press advocacy groups condemned the move as a violation of the First Amendment.

item.title: Trump to form ‘AI Force,’ name AI czar but rejects calls for constraints
item.description: A growing chorus of lawmakers and industry leaders have called for moving more slowly on the technology.

item.title: Hispanics flock to this university. It let campus police double as ICE agents.
item.description: Leaders of Florida International University signed an agreement to deputize its school police as immigration agents. Some wish they had put up more of a fight.

item.title: Secret contracts reveal undisclosed terms in Trump’s drug-pricing deals
item.description: Agreements with Pfizer and Eli Lilly include tariff protections, overseas pricing inducements and broad confidentiality clauses.

item.title: How anti-Muslim rhetoric is influencing the pivotal Michigan Senate race
item.description: Attacks aimed at Democrat Abdul El-Sayed have brought back painful memories for some in a contest that has raised questions about the acceptability of Islamophobia in politics.

item.title: Behind Trump’s public confidence, his private view of midterms is sobering
item.description: In private, the president has been hearing blunt news from advisers about the GOP’s poor chances in the midterms and has accepted that some of the problem is of his making.

item.title: White House budget chief pushes for scrutiny of NIH grants in Oval Office clash
item.description: Russell Vought argued the agency has been funding “woke” priorities and suggested the president create a commission to review grants from the National Institutes of Health.

item.title: Trump hails Greenland security deal that falls short of takeover
item.description: The agreement, which Danish officials said is not final, stops far short of Trump's often-stated goal of taking possession of the territory.
